connect_mcp_server: connect an MCP client to a server URL with optional HTTP headers
list_tool_specs: list available tool specs from a connected MCP server including names, descriptions, and parameters
call_tool: call an MCP tool by function name with arguments and return the result content
list_resources: list available resources from a connected MCP server with optional pagination cursor
read_resource: read a resource from a connected MCP server by URI and return its content
